name: TrueFoundry
short: AI gateway and deployment platform with LLM/MCP/agent gateways, prompt management, guardrails, budget limiting, observability, and VPC/on-prem/air-gapped options.

plans.name: Developer (Free)
plans.notes: Up to 3 users, 10,000 requests & tool calls per user per month, LLM & MCP gateway, prompts/skills/agent registry, 7-day log retention, community support (Discord).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited users, 20,000 requests/user/month, built-in guardrails, budget limiting, 30-day log retention, SSO & custom roles, dedicated support; overage $20 per additional 100,000 requests.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom retention & audit exports, external IdP, third-party/custom guardrails (Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI), advanced observability, VPC/on-prem/data residency, priority support; Agent Gateway/Agent Harness custom.
